Heard of any rumors?
Whole lotta nothing, [them-regID]. I'm beginning to think we're the only two ships out here.
Another ship got spammed an empty packet. Uncompressed, all zeroes. Fifth time this week. Either someone is playing a prank or...well, I don't know what.
A couple of dopes in the OE managed to get themselves locked in the Mescaform freezer. Barkeep found them the next morning frostbitten and drunk as all sin. One of them lost a finger.
There's a fight club on OKLG, apparently. Bunch of desk jockeys getting their anger out. Not a fighter myself, but I'd take a gander.
Breaker's Union can't get enough support from the rank and file for a strike. I'm starting to think Ayo is seeding it with saboteurs.
Folks keep saying they're seeing something purple floating outside their ship. Ever heard of The Mariner? I'm not superstitious myself but that one...that one gets me.
More and more punk kids wearing purple and getting stoned on OKLG. I know what they're getting at, who they are trying to meet. But I'm not gonna say it.
Piracy is completely out of control around the Venus aerostats. They hit a dozen ships last week. Folks won't even fly from Newcal to Encantado to watch the races. Shameful shit if you ask me.
New clerk at the Port Authority seems like a pushover. Buddy of mine sweet talked her way out of a few docking fees. She's a looker, but still.
New clerk at the Port Authority scares easy. They dropped my docking fee after I gave them the ol' prison yard stare. Who says you can't learn anything in the joint?

Buddy of mine, a porter, heard something banging around one of their empty cabins the other night. Thought it was a stowaway. When they checked the cams, though, there was static in the center of the picture, near the bed. Damndest thing.
You remember that ship that escaped the Perpetual Protein lab breach? Name of The Lesser Key of Solomon? I heard it was spotted along the Ganymed orbit.
I've been seeing more and more of those vat grown cats, you know? From Hyun Lee Petware? I don't understand the appeal myself.
I don't understand why everyone is so freaked out about the Perpetual Protein thing. Meat is meat, as far as I'm concerned. You think Trencher's is any better?
That Professor Park Hyun Lee is a true bastard. Unleashing that monstrosity on the world. And for what? G-mod goat meat? Space him, I say.
Two horns, two eyes and a smiling tooth. Arranged just above his cloven hoof. Then from the void you'll hear the drums. For this is how the Goatman comes.
Heard some freak managed to climb up the well at Prokofiev, if you can believe it.
You ever tried lusca before? A buddy of mine says they serve it at weddings on Hangzhou. Melts like butter, he said.
I've been off of long-hauling for so long now, my body aches when I put my boots on. I gotta get a line on some Ossifex.

The Harbourmaster has been more paranoid than usual lately. Has a private detail guarding his quarters all night. Running 12 hour shifts. The whole thing has become a huge drain on department resources.
We keep seeing tags of the number 79 around the station, especially over there in the OE? I think it's bored kids but my boss insists it's some kind of cult.
I don't know what to make of this living meat story. Everyone I've seen talk about it seems half-insane.
